mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_product ( product_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, price INT NOT NULL, stock INT NOT NULL, product_desc TEXT )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_product(product_id, name, price, stock, product_desc) VALUES (#{productId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{desc}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), price = VALUES(price), stock = VALUES(stock), product_desc = VALUES(product_desc)
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, name, price, stock, product_desc FROM cs_product WHERE name LIKE #{keywordPattern} ORDER BY product_id
SELECT product_id, name, price, stock, product_desc FROM cs_product ORDER BY product_id
